titulo: Infinite Zoom Into a Contour Map, Timed to Gongs
caption:
Infinite Zoom Into a Contour Map, Timed to Gongs

The bells set the speed of the fall, and when they stop, the fall stops with them. Let it play twice: the last frame runs into the first. A wordless exploration of contour lines and music.

Music made with ElevenLabs.

#infinitezoom #contourlines #generativeart
descripcion:
An infinite zoom animation that falls into a contour map without end, through the same land again and again.
Bronze bells set the speed of the fall, slow and huge at first and frantic by 20 seconds. Then a hard silence stops the fall dead, and one low gong lets it drift out. The last frame runs into the first, so it loops.
A wordless NAOS exploration of contour lines and sound.

Music made with ElevenLabs.
Every NAOS strategy and its sources: https://hardlypythonnmr.github.io/naos-site/biblioteca/

#infinitezoom #contourlines #generativeart
alt: Endless zoom into a glowing contour map on near black. Neon lines in six bright colors ring round hills and hollows. The camera falls into them while slowly turning, and the same shapes come back at every scale. The fall speeds up to a rush, stops dead on a frozen frame, then drifts slowly to rest where the video began. No text, no people.
